At sunrise, the boat was gone, but on the rocks below lay a second bottle, empty except for a single white feather.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台暂时停下的机器。高架桥上偶有汽车掠过，轮胎声被雾气磨得很轻。便利店的灯还亮着，店员趴在柜台边打盹，咖啡机发出低低的响声。写字楼的窗格大多漆黑，只有几层亮着，像夜空里固执的星。清洁车慢慢经过路口，扫起落叶和昨夜的喧闹。远处菜市场开始卸货，灯泡摇晃，人声渐起。天边尚未发白，城市却已在沉默中悄悄醒来。","w03":"- Recursion is when a set of instructions solves a problem by asking itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem.\n- It must have a stopping rule, like reaching the smallest box, so it does not keep going forever.\n- Imagine opening nested dolls: each doll contains a smaller doll until you reach the tiniest one."}
